title: Alexandria: A Library of Pluralistic Values for Realtime Re-Ranking of Social Media Feeds
reasoning: The paper identifies and operationalizes a library of 78 pluralistic human values—including moral, ethical, and spiritual ones such as 'Honest', 'Forgiving', 'Care', and 'Salvation' (defined as spiritual deliverance)—sourced from frameworks like Rokeach and Maslow. It evaluates the ability of LLMs to classify content according to these moral and value-based dimensions.
